sourceAnchors.message: If you run in Java5 or newer and have concurrent access, you should use the ConcurrentHashMap implementation
sourceAnchors.reason: decodeArea creates a method-local LinkedHashMap, fills it only within that invocation and constructs a FieldValueSet from it. Independent concurrent codec callers have separate maps; this is no concurrently shared mutable map.

sourceAnchors.message: Use equals() to compare object references.
sourceAnchors.reason: The references are Throwables. Identity intentionally determines whether the same Throwable would be attached to itself via suppressed failures; equals() could be overridden and must not replace the identity contract. Whole original tests verify distinct and identical causes.

sourceAnchors.message: Avoid using equals() to compare against null
sourceAnchors.reason: Intentional negative public value contract requiring equality false for null. This is a test assertion, not production null comparison logic.
